name: Shishihara Shin Kaname
source:
A man who is said to be the strongest Youma at the moment. He is a lion-class Youma who can transform from human to Youma and back, known as "Kakusei-mono". 

A quarter-Indian, effeminate person. He is Rin's target of revenge, and since Rin always throws a wrench in his plans at every opportunity she gets, he also aims to take her life. 

[Slightly edited and translated from [url=http://www.lilith-soft.com/lilith/product44/04chara_3.html]Official Site[/url]]
